evidence_items.explanation: A functioning comparator and extensive evaluations existed before the post, providing material evidence of progress. The authors nevertheless report English-only coverage, false positives and false negatives, and limits on appropriate use; this does not establish Marcus's unspecified broad accuracy standard.

TRUE documents useful results from entailment and question-answering methods alongside residual errors and evaluation-label problems. It supports caution about reliability but supplies no equivalence between comparison technology and solving AGI.

unresolved_gaps: No stated threshold distinguishes very high accuracy from the demonstrated benchmark performance.
The available studies do not establish the full breadth of semantic comparison intended in the claim.
No retrieved evidence establishes or refutes the claimed difficulty relationship with a defined AGI task.
